test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Bill said, “I have missed my train. I will be late for work.”

options.text: Bill said that he missed his train and that he will be late for work.
Bill said that I have missed my train and that I would be late for work.
Bill said that he had missed his train and that he would be late for work.
Bill said that he has missed his train and that he is late for work.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Bill said that he had missed his train and that he would be late for work.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• In the given sentence the reporting verb has no object. Hence, 'said' will not be changed. 
 
• **Comma** and **inverted commas** will be removed. 
 
• The **conjunction** 'that' will be added.
 
• 'I' will be changed into 'he' because the first person pronoun is changed according to the subject of the reporting verb. 
 
• **'have missed'** will be changed into** 'had missed'.**
 
• **'will be'** changes into **'would be'.**

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Bill said that he had missed his train and that he would be late for work.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **डायरेक्ट स्पीच **में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे** इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच** में बदलना है।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में **reporting verb** का कोई **object **नहीं है। इसलिए, '**said**' नहीं बदला जाएगा।
 
• अल्पविराम और उल्टे अल्पविराम हटा दिए जाएंगे।
 
• **Conjunction** '**that**' जोड़ा जाएगा।
 
• **'I' **को** 'he' **में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि **reporting verb** के **subject** के अनुसार** first person pronoun **बदल दिया गया है।
 
• **'have missed'** को **'had missed'** में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• **'will be'** **'would be'** में बदल जाएगा।
